Bait of our future suffering

About this piece

#Inktober Day 3 prompt was “bait.” I couldn’t help but think of all the shiny new colors and exciting new flavors that the tobacco industry has successfully managed to “accidentally” get into the hands of our youth.

My father-in-law, a career school psychologist, volunteers tirelessly at a local junior high to try to reverse the course of action that JUUL and other modern-day criminal companies have initiated.
